title: Sample: what is worth waking someone up for?
description: Sample post for local development: a simple test for which alerts should ring a phone at night and which can wait.
tldr: Wake someone only when a person must act now.
Everything else can wait for the morning.
Write the alert so the person knows what to do.
markdown:
Too many night alerts teach people to ignore them. A good rule keeps the phone quiet unless a person must act now.

## When should a phone ring?

Ring a phone when waiting would cause real harm and a person can stop it.

1. Money is about to move the wrong way.
2. Customers cannot use the product.
3. An agent needs a yes before a risky step.

## What can wait until morning?

Slow pages, single failed jobs and warnings that fix themselves can wait.

## How do I write a good alert?

Say what happened, what it affects, and the one thing to do first.

## What to do next

[Try M91: send your first alert in a few minutes.](https://m91.msg91.com/)
